title: Tokuso Kidoutai J-SWAT
native_title: 特捜機動隊ジェイスワット
overview:
As a member of J-SWAT, you head out to arrest criminals hiding in buildings, warehouses and other locations. You are equipped with handguns, submachine guns and more, and unless you also deploy your personnel appropriately for the situation, completing the mission will be difficult. Now, are you ready? Let's go! Move in!!!

君はJSWATの一員として、ビルや倉庫などに潜む犯人の逮捕に向かう。
ハンドガンやサブマシンガンなど装備、状況に応じて適切な人員配置もしなければ、ミッションの達成は難しい。
さあ、準備は整ったか？行くぞ！突入!!!
